dogecoin.text:
It’s 2013. 

Dogecoin launched just two days ago, and a fellow named James McMurry has just heard about Bitcoin.

James gets curious. 

After researching for a while, he gets an idea.

He starts a YT channel and uploads a video about his own version of Bitcoin.

He calls it https://t.co/4Mvtguozcn
